note: The vans of the blueprint van (World.Vehicles.Van). Lengths in meters. A trace is a line of points [d, z]: d back from the front (or from the back), z up from the ground; "top" is the height of the roof. The points of a trace over 2 m stretch to the height of the model, so the cab keeps its height.

ford_transit.name: Ford Transit (US, 2020 to 2026)
sources: The traces of the side: the previews of the drawings of Outlines (getoutlines.com), 2019 to 2023, as in DIY, and the side photo of the owner (a Transit 148 in, medium roof).

Ford, Transit Body Builders Layout Book, 2022 model year, pages 18 to 24, and 2025 Ford Transit Technical Specifications, page 4: the length, the width, the heights, the wheelbase, the overhangs, the tracks, the openings of the doors, the height of the floor.

Measured on side photos of dealers (2022, 2023 and 2026 Transit-250, high roof, 148 in), with the wheelbase as the scale: the hood, the windshield, the lamps, the bands, the bumpers, the mirrors, the seams of the doors.
ford_transit.front_note: The center line of the front, from the bottom of the bumper to the top of the windshield: Ford, Body Builders Layout Book 2022, page 21 (the cab, near to scale), and the side photos of dealers.

sources: The windows of the passenger van and of the crew van (2026 and 2027 Transit T-350 XL, XLT and HD XL, 148 in): measured from the photos and the renders of Ford on the pages of dealers, with the wheelbase as the scale. x is from the front axle, z is from the ground, to 0.03 m. Medium roof: https://www.comvoy.com/work-van/arlington-wi/new-2026-ford-transit-350-xl-passenger-van-24080301, https://www.comvoy.com/work-van/colusa-ca/new-2026-ford-transit-350-xl-passenger-van-24727906, https://www.comvoy.com/work-van/brandon-ms/new-2027-ford-transit-350-xl-passenger-van-24178470, https://www.comvoy.com/work-van/kansas-city-mo/new-2026-ford-transit-350-xl-passenger-van-22784884. High roof: https://www.comvoy.com/work-van/starke-fl/new-2026-ford-transit-350-xl-passenger-van-23229223, https://www.comvoy.com/work-van/silsbee-tx/new-2027-ford-transit-350-xl-passenger-van-24900435, https://www.comvoy.com/work-van/sacramento-ca/new-2026-ford-transit-350-xlt-passenger-van-23683021. Extended: https://www.comvoy.com/work-van/manassas-va/new-2026-ford-transit-350-hd-xl-passenger-van-22388427, https://www.comvoy.com/work-van/hawthorne-ca/new-2026-ford-transit-350-hd-xl-passenger-van-24447026.

The crew van (2020 Transit 250, 148 in, medium roof): the glass of the sliding door only, at the right side: https://vanlifetrader.com/listing/partial-build-2020-ford-transit-crew-250-rwd-148″-wb-medium-roof/. The window of the second row at the left side is not measured: it is the first window of the passenger van.

openings.note: x is from the front axle, z from the ground (meters).
sources: The front door: its seam at 1.27 m behind the front axle and its window from x 0.10 to 1.16 m (the photos and renders of dealers, transit_passenger notes). Its front edge over the arch of the wheel and its bottom at 0.42 m: by eye from the same photos.
The sliding door: 1300 by 1601 mm (Ford, Body Builders Layout Book 2022), from 1.3 m behind the front axle; the door is from 0.42 to 2.36 m (the photos of dealers).

The rear doors: from the lamps at the back (0.095 m in from the side) to the middle, from 0.71 m (over the bumper) to 0.05 m over the opening, which is 1887 mm (high roof) or 1648 mm (medium roof) high from the floor (Ford, Body Builders Layout Book 2022; the photos of dealers).

seats.note: x across from the center line, d back from the front axle, to the center of the cushion; height of the top of the cushion above its floor.
sources: The seats and their rows: by eye from the photos of the inside of a 2026 Transit passenger van (https://www.comvoy.com/work-van/fenton-mi/new-2026-ford-transit-350-xl-passenger-van-25226733); Ford gives 12 seats in four rows (2, 3, 3, 4).
